27:56.text: There was no other answer given by his people except that they said: "Drive out the family of Lût
from your city Verily, these are men who want to be clean and pure!"

27:57.text: So We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

27:58.text: And We rained down on them a rain
. So evil was the rain of those who were warned.

27:59.text: : "Praise and thanks be to Allâh, and peace be on His slaves whom He has chosen

27:60.text: Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water
from the sky, whereby We cause to grow wonderful gardens full of beauty and delight? It is not in your ability to cause the growth of their trees. Is there any ilâh
with Allâh? Nay, but they are a people who ascribe equals

27:61.text: Who has made the earth as a fixed abode, and has placed rivers in its midst, and has placed firm mountains therein, and has set a barrier between the two seas
with Allâh? Nay, but most of them know not!

27:62.text: Who responds to the distressed one, when he calls on Him, and Who removes the evil, and makes you inheritors of the earth, generations after generations? Is there any ilâh
with Allâh? Little is that you remember!

27:63.text: Who guides you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy
with Allâh? High Exalted be Allâh above all that they associate as partners
